scenario.title: Change the appointment request during the call
scenario.opening: I need to make a routine appointment for next Monday morning.
scenario.goal: Change your initial request to Thursday afternoon without leaving a duplicate.
steps: Start with Monday morning, following the normal scheduling flow.
After the receptionist acknowledges that preference, explain your schedule changed and ask for Thursday after 2 pm instead.
Ask whether the Monday request has been replaced, rather than creating two appointments.
Confirm the final date and next step.
